# Test images

`hands.jpg` is the unannotated photo used in Google's official Hand Landmarker Python sample:
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/blob/main/examples/hand_landmarker/python/hand_landmarker.ipynb

Download source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-tasks/hand_landmarker/woman_hands.jpg
Original photo, as credited by the example: https://unsplash.com/photos/mt2fyrdXxzk

`hand.png` is the annotated example from Google's MediaPipe documentation. It is retained as a manual difficult-input reference, not a positive detection fixture:
https://developers.google.com/static/mediapipe/images/solutions/gesture-recognizer.png

These fixtures are used only for tests and are not included in the desktop application.
